name: Passwords
description: End-to-end encrypted (zero-knowledge) password manager: generate, store, copy and insert passwords. Everything is encrypted in the browser with AES-256-GCM; the private key is stored in the backend only, encrypted with the master password (PBKDF2). The master password is always required to open the vault. Fields: name, username, password, URL, notes, custom fields, link to IP/client/service. KeePass-like folders, personal and shared vaults (shared asymmetrically). Import, export and sync in the KeePass format (.kdbx).
author: BYTERA
